a01.text: Close to six months with one employer?

a02.text: On a working holiday visa, your job might be exempt.

a03.text: One. The default rule is six months' work with any one employer.

a04.text: It counts the months since you started, not your hours.

a05.text: Two. Some sectors are exempt right now,

a09.text: You can stay longer if each location is six months or less.

a10b.text: You'd need permission, and it's only given in limited cases.

a11.text: Save this before you sign your next job.
